actions.name: Accurate Strikes
actions.description: For 1 round, the mech treats all of its operators as though they each had a number of Piloting ranks equal to their respective levels for the purpose of calculating the mech's attack bonuses.

description.value:
Energy rods and heat sinks boost attack accuracy.

@PPAbility[cost:1]{Accurate Strikes} All operators are treated as having Piloting ranks equal to their levels for 1 round.
